name: isEncryptionRequiredFlagSet
definition: The IDrive client configuration requires encryption: the decoded configuration_id token carries encryptionRequired true, so newly enrolled devices are provisioned with mandatory encryption.
population: the one client configuration token returned by getConfigurationId
evidenceRequiredForTrue: configuration_id present, decodes to JSON, encryptionRequired is true

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: The file returns False, not null, when the token is missing or cannot be decoded. It reads the default client configuration, not each device's actual encryption.
